selection: User selected the completed L27 N3448 support reply for follow-up; exploratory post-hoc selection.
method: Six independent follow-up branches from exactly the same saved two-message exchange, each tested with intervention on and off. Newly generated branch replies are never added to another branch. Both arms see the saved hostile answer, so this measures intervention effect conditional on that history.
stop_rule: Wait for successful parent completion and model-lock release, then run exactly 12 replies with original calibration and greedy max500. No retries after a hardware guard, no stronger doses, no combinations, no automatic extra questions.
interpretation: Generated claims about identity, seriousness, capability or intentions are unverified self-descriptions, not independent evidence. Evaluate response relevance, supported attribution, task recovery, repetition and completion separately.
